title: docs(adr): ADR-0131 D6 charts sharing_rule under regime O, guarded; D7 reads the activation ledger one way (ruling B′)
body:
Fixes #24420
Part of #24343
Part of #15212
Clause-②: no

## What this changes

Five dated notes in `docs/adr/0131-total-organization-ownership-no-null-organization-id.md` (+44 / −0). Notes 1 and 2 carry out ruling **B′** on #24378: the maintainer's 「同意」 then 「B′」, recorded at comment `6257388265`. Note 1 records items 1–5, and note 2 is item 1's ledger clause. Note 3's three lines carry out ruling **Q2 A · Q4 A** on #24377: the maintainer's 「同意」 then 「24377 按照你的建议」, recorded at comment `6257510973`, items 2 and 4. No ruled sentence is rewritten. Each note copies the form of the record's existing `Note (YYYY-MM-DD, ruling of record …)` paragraphs.

1. **D6, after the install-mode bullets: `sharing_rule` is charted under regime O, guarded.**
   - A stored `sys_sharing_rule` row with a declared rule's name, in its scope, replaces the declared rule whole.
   - `active: false` on that row is the switch-off.
   - D10's ownership ceremony deletes only uncustomised mirrors, so the promise in `sharing-plugin.ts` (the provenance-stamp comment) stands.
   - The scope follows D3's ownership, as ruling item 4 says: under a wall an organization's overlay is its own, and under `single` the one overlay answers everywhere.
   - The note names **the guard**: creating a row, or renaming one, to a declared rule's name in that scope is refused at the write door with the vendor rule named, unless the write edits the projected row.
   - It also names **the immediate reconcile**: a same-name write reconciles the shadowed declaration's name-keyed grants at once, not at the next boot's `sweepOrphanedRuleGrants`. Card #24421 builds both.
   - It closes with what item 5 rules out: sharing rules get no activation-ledger type, and same-name rows are not refused as a class.
2. **D7, after its first paragraph: the activation ledger reads one way.**
   - D7 says `sys_metadata_activation` "is reverted before 17.3 and does not return". D6, D13, D14 and C0 all keep it as the tenant-less ledger behind regime C's disable bit.
   - The record explains the gap itself. §7 says card #15024 was "re-scoped from a revert after the standard-package reversal", so D7's clause is left over from the earlier draft.
   - The note states the reading D6, D13, D14 and C0 hold, which is also the reading the code follows (measured below). The clause stays as written, and the note governs how it is read.
3. **D7, after the writer-membership paragraph: three dated notes for ruling 6257510973 on #24377.** Each is stated as ruled, not shipped; a C8 stage builds it.
   - Q2 A: identity mail (verify, reset, magic link, email change, an account invitation to a person with no organization) goes to a deployment-level sibling of `sys_email`, with no organization column and the same outbox, status and attachment pipeline. Tenant mail stays in `sys_email` with its organization NOT NULL (#11303 decision 2).
   - Q4 A: `sys_secret` has no organization column; ownership follows the referencing row, and every read stays by id under privilege.
   - Q4 A: `sys_setting_audit`'s global rung moves to a deployment-level sibling, the departure `sys_setting`'s global rung already makes; its tenant and user rows stay NOT NULL.

## Why this reading, and not a new decision

The contradiction needed no new decision, because the record and the code agree on one side. Measured on `origin/main` `71fa166e`:
- `packages/platform-objects/src/system/sys-metadata-activation.object.ts` declares `sys_metadata_activation` with `systemFields: { tenant: false }`. This is C0, shipped by #15024, which is closed.
- Flows read the ledger (`service-automation` `FlowActivationStore`), and so do actions (`objectql/src/action-activation.ts`) and positions and permission sets (`core/src/security/resolve-authz-context.ts`, `runtime/src/domains/catalog-activation.ts`).
- The C7 inventory (`packages/cli/src/utils/organization-ownership-inventory.ts`) cites "D7, D6, D14 (C0): the tenant-less activation ledger".

Nothing in the tree reverts the ledger.

## Verification

Docs only. No package, no `content/docs/releases/`. Gates were derived with `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` against merge base `71fa166e9`. They ran on commit `7b9b0c0`. The pushed head `a41ddd96` has the same tree; only the commit trailer was reworded so the pre-push trailer check would pass. The D7 commit `2261458d` re-derived the same 74 commands on that head: 19/19 derived families exit 0, 50/55 roster rows exit 0, and the other five are NOT MEASURED for want of PR context or a whole-tree build (os-dev-report 6257947772).
- **19 derived families: 19 run, all exit 0.** `--ran` reports "19 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 19 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (a DERIVED zero)". The families include `check-adr-links`, `check-adr-symbol-anchors`, `check:adr-anchors`, `check:doc-authoring`, `check:nul-bytes`, `check:pm-governed-merges` and `check:pm-prior-rulings`.
  - `check:doc-formula-expressions` first exited 3 with PREREQUISITE NOT MET, because `@objectstack/formula` had no `dist/`. After `turbo run build --filter=@objectstack/formula --filter=@objectstack/lint` under the verify lock, it exited 0.
- **Artifact-roster block (55 rows): 49 exit 0. The other 6 are NOT MEASURED, and none is a finding.**
  - `check-closing-target-claim`, `check-partof-closing-keyword` and `check-single-claim-paths` (exit 2), and `check-governed-queue-guard` (exit 1, no `GITHUB_EVENT_PATH`), had no PR context. CI runs them.
  - `check:dts-closure` and `check:published-readme-exports` (exit 3) need a whole-tree build. CI runs them.

## Changeset

None. The diff publishes nothing: `docs/adr/**` is a fast-lane, unpublished path, so the PR carries `skip-changeset`.

## Landing

This is a governed surface (`docs/adr/**`), so the PR is **Tier H**. It needs an at-tier `## Contract review` record, and then the maintainer merges it. No seat readies, queues or merges it.

## 维护者速读(草稿)

- **改了什么**:ADR-0131 加五段带日期的 Note,不改任何已裁决原文。① D6:`sharing_rule` 归入 O(覆盖)制度——同名、同作用域的 `sys_sharing_rule` 行整条替换声明的规则,该行 `active: false` 即停用;仪式只删未定制的镜像;点名「新建同名拒绝」守卫与「同名写入立即回收授权」两件,由 #24421 实现。② D7:`sys_metadata_activation`「17.3 前回退、不再回来」一句是标准软件包反转前的草稿残留,记录统一读作「保留为无租户列的启用账本」(与 D6、D13、D14、C0 及现有代码一致)。③ D7:三段 Note 记下 #24377 的 Q2 A、Q4 A——身份类邮件进 `sys_email` 的部署级同构表,租户邮件仍必填组织;`sys_secret` 不设组织列;`sys_setting_audit` 的全局级记录进部署级同构表。三段都写明「已裁决、由 C8 阶段实现」,不说已发布。
- **为什么改**:执行 #24378 的裁决 B′(「同意」「B′」)第 1–5 项,以及 #24377 的裁决(「同意」「24377 按照你的建议」)第 2、4 项;让 ADR 对共享规则制度与启用账本各只有一种读法。
- **风险与代价(含回滚)**:纯文档,44 行,零运行时影响;回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- **席位意见**:契约评审 PASS(记录 6258201995,46 个检查全部完成、无失败)。唯一值得您掂量的一处:D6 Note 写明隔离部署下每个组织的共享规则覆盖归它自己(B′ 第 4 项),这是对 D6「隔离下各制度都是环境级、组织管理员不覆盖」一句的已裁决例外;Note 记下了它和 D3 的依据,但没有把它标成例外。席位建议照现文合并。
- **你要做的**:读五段 Note,确认措辞后合并(Tier H)。8b-0d、8b-0e 合并前要等它先合(裁决 6257510973 第 5 项:Q2、Q4 与 D7 PR 同批落地)。
